stem: Please listen to this short update. Which detail is stated in the message?

the green bottle claim has a source but no test conditions：此項把「no test method or source」改成「a source but no test conditions」。音稿明確陳述「the green bottle claim has no test method or source」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the green bottle claim has no test method or source」。
the green bottle claim has no test method or source：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「the green bottle claim has no test method or source」。
